subject: Exec touchstone: outcome summary, procurement path & open escalations
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@heliosretail.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@heliosretail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-29T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Exec touchstone: outcome summary, procurement path & open escalations

Claire / Tom — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from my side to make sure we’re aligned and to make next steps explicit.

Top-line goals you shared:
- Reduce time-to-inventory-insight (SKU-level) from days to under 2 hours for store ops leaders.
- Keep average inference cost per query under $0.015 for the pilot (projected scale: ~120k queries/month).
- Maintain strict PII handling and retain audit logs for 13 months to meet your compliance window.

Primary pain points we heard:
1) Current ML endpoints are fragile during peak ingest (holiday spikes) and cause 3–4x latency swings.
2) Security/compliance checklist (SOC2, IP handling) is a gating item for procurement.
3) Procurement needs a clear SLA/upgrade path and a simple mutual action plan to present to legal.

Proposed path and asks (mutual action items):
- Redwood will provide: a) a 30-day pilot (dedicated capacity) with observability hooks exposed to your ops team, b) a SOC2 summary + standard controls mapping, c) an initial cost projection based on your query profile.
- Helios will provide: a) the ingestion sample and token distribution (anonymized) by 9/3, b) a single legal contact + procurement timeline by 9/7.

Escalation items (we flagged internally):
- If SOC2 evidence is required beyond the summary, we’ll route through our Private offering (longer lead time).
- If peak concurrency > 700 qps during pilot, we’ll need to convert to reserved capacity to keep latencies in target.

Attachments: I’ve dropped a short Mutual Action Plan spreadsheet and a SOC2 executive summary into the Drive link below and attached locally for quick reference.

Next steps (concrete):
1) Claire: confirm point of contact for procurement + preferred contract team (legal@ or procurement@) by 9/7.
2) Helios: share anonymized ingest sample by 9/3.
3) Redwood (Aditya): run a quick cost-estimate and send before EOD 9/1.

Happy to jump on a follow-up with your procurement and security folks next week — proposing Tues 9/8 10:00–10:30 PT. If that works, I’ll send calendar invites and include our compliance lead.

Thanks — Mark

--
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0172

Attachments: MutualActionPlan-Helios.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-Summary.pdf (pdf)
From: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@heliosretail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@heliosretail.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec touchstone: outcome summary, procurement path & open escalations

Markus — thanks for the crisp recap. Confirming a few details from our side:

- Procurement contact: I’ll route paperwork to procurement@heliosretail.com and loop in Legal (primary contact: Melissa Park, melissa.park@heliosretail.com). I’ll introduce you to them this week.
- Data sample: Tom will deliver the anonymized payload by 9/3; we’ll remove direct PII but keep distribution stats.
- SOC2: the executive summary looks fine for our security team’s initial read; they may request system-level logs later.

Follow-up: Tue 9/8 10:00 PT works for a 30m sync with procurement + security. Please include whoever owns your Private deployment timeline in that invite.

Quick ask: Can you put the cost-estimate in an itemized table (per-query, per-embedding, and projected monthly spend) so our finance team can slot it into the evaluation pack?

Best — Claire
Director, Data & Analytics | Helios Retail
claire.jensen@heliosretail.com
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.jensen@heliosretail.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@heliosretail.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec touchstone: outcome summary, procurement path & open escalations

Claire — perfect, appreciate the fast turnaround. Will do on the itemized cost table. Aditya — can you draft the cost breakdown and include a low/nominal/high usage scenario (tokens per month) and a note on what triggers reserved capacity? Trying to keep the finance ask tight.

Also noting: if legal requests system-level logs (beyond the SOC2 summary) we should surface our Private deployment timelines (2–4 weeks for packaging + onboarding). Grace — can you prepare a one-slide timeline we can share in the procurement call on Tue?

I’ll queue the calendar invite for Tue 9/8 10:00 PT and include Melissa Park from Legal once Claire introduces.

Thanks — Mark

Date: 2026-08-31T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: prep for Helios procurement sync (slide + timeline)

Markus / Aditya — prepping the one-slide timeline and a short note on the escalation triggers. Draft below; I’ll attach the slide to the invite.

Draft slide bullets:
- Pilot kickoff (dedicated capacity): target 9/15 — lasts 30 days
- Observable metrics shared daily: latency p50/p95, token volume, cost per 1k tokens
- Escalation triggers: sustained p95 > 800ms for 30m OR unexpected PII alert (immediate)
- Compliance path: SOC2 summary provided now; if system logs required -> Private deployment (2–4 weeks packaging)
- Procurement checklist: SOW + Mutual Action Plan + preferred legal contacts

Aditya — I’ll need the cost scenarios by EOD so I can add them to the slide. I’ll also add a brief note on what reserved capacity pricing looks like vs. pilot.

Grace
Director, Customer Success Operations | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com
